270160.effectText: Use: Deploy the Shellward to absorb up to 40% of incoming damage until 553145 damage has been prevented for up to 30 sec. The Shellward hardens while you are below 40% health, reducing damage by 80% instead. Deal 22016 Physical damage to melee attackers while the Shellward holds. (1 Min, 30 Sec Cooldown)

270161.effectText: Equip: Your harmful spells have a very high chance to befoul your target with Umbral Malignance, dealing ( 267 * 1 ) Shadow damage every 3 sec for 1 min, stacking up to 30 times. Umbral Malignance bursts upon the target's death, dealing 300% of its remaining damage split between nearby enemies and applying Umbral Malignance.

270162.effectText: Use: Call forth 5 Soulcoiler Cultist spirits over 2 sec and sacrifice their essence, each granting an ally a barrier reducing damage taken by 50% for 20 sec or until ( 406015 * 1 ) damage has been prevented. Allied deaths reduce this cooldown by 30 sec and immediately summon a Soulcoil Cultist spirit for sacrifice. (2 Min Cooldown)

270163.effectText: Equip: You have a high chance to follow up your attacks with Ravage, Mutilate, or Tempest based on the number of nearby enemies. Your killer instincts are honed, triggering this effect on your next attack upon defeating an enemy. May only occur once per 10 sec.

270164.effectText: Equip: You have a chance to pull an artifact of questionable value out of the bag when casting spells and abilities, enhancing your secondary stats in various ways. There are probably no fish left in the bag, but it's hard to be sure. (750ms cooldown)

270165.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a high chance to grant you Focus of Ula'tek, increasing your Haste by 132 for 12 sec. Multiple applications may overlap. When two or more applications are active, your focus sharpens further to increase the effect by 20%.

270166.effectText: Equip: Your attacks have a very high chance to build sanguine rancor within you. After 15 times, the rancor erupts to scourge your target and all nearby enemies with crimson bile, dealing ( 101324 * 1 ) Shadow damage split between them. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%. If only one enemy is struck, the concentrated bile deals an additional ( 101324 * 25 / 100 * 1 ) Shadow damage over 3 sec.

270167.effectText: Equip: Your spells have a high chance to call to the sea, granting Tidal Insight to increase your Intellect by 71 up to 6 times. After reaching its peak, your spells instead diminish Tidal Insight before beginning the cycle anew.

270168.effectText: Use: Channel a torrent of venomous rage over 2 sec, dealing ( 1 * 906988 ) Nature damage to your target and splattering all nearby enemies for ( 1 * 159616 ) Nature damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets. (4 Min Cooldown)

270169.effectText: Equip: Your spells afflict you with Hex Lord's Doom, draining your Intellect by 5 up to 30 times. This effect may occur once every 6 sec. (6s cooldown) Use: Consume the power of Hex Lord's Doom, increasing your Intellect by 34 per stack for 30 sec. (30 Sec Cooldown)
